radar.subtitle: Tap any scam below to see how it works, read a safe fictional sample, and learn what to do right now.

atlas.immediateAction: What to do if you receive this

upi_collect.title: UPI Collect Request Fraud
upi_collect.summary: Scammers send a 'Receive Money' QR code or UPI collect request. Entering your PIN transfers money OUT of your account.
upi_collect.goldenRule: UPI PIN is only required to SEND money, NEVER to receive money.
upi_collect.howItWorks: 1. The scammer pretends to buy an item or send prize money. 2. They send a QR code or UPI request labeled 'Tap to receive'. 3. They tell you on the phone: 'Enter your PIN to accept'. 4. The moment you enter your PIN, money leaves your account.
upi_collect.hooks: "Enter your PIN to claim payment" / "Scan this QR code to receive government cashback"
upi_collect.immediateAction: Never enter your UPI PIN. Reject the collect request inside your UPI app right away.
upi_collect.fictionalText: Dear Customer, your ₹25,000 refund is pending. Tap https://upi-refund-fast.fictional/claim and enter your UPI PIN on next screen to receive funds.

digital_arrest.title: Fake Police / Digital Arrest Call
digital_arrest.summary: Imposters posing as Police, Customs, or CBI call on video claiming your Aadhaar is linked to illegal parcels and demanding fund transfers.
digital_arrest.goldenRule: Indian police or CBI never conduct arrests, trials, or fund transfers over WhatsApp or Skype calls.
digital_arrest.howItWorks: 1. You receive an automated call claiming an illegal parcel under your name was seized. 2. A fake officer on video shows a forged police backdrop. 3. They claim you are under 'Digital Arrest' and cannot hang up. 4. They demand you transfer your savings to a 'verification account'.
digital_arrest.hooks: "You are under digital arrest" / "Do not disconnect or local police will reach your house in 30 minutes"
digital_arrest.immediateAction: Hang up immediately. There is no legal procedure known as 'Digital Arrest' in India.
digital_arrest.fictionalText: NOTICE: Immediate summons. Your Aadhaar is linked to narcotics interception at cargo. Join video interrogation immediately or non-bailable warrant will be issued.

kyc_electricity.title: Electricity Bill / SIM Disconnection Alert
kyc_electricity.summary: Urgent SMS claiming power or mobile service will be cut off tonight unless you call a personal mobile number or download an app.
kyc_electricity.goldenRule: Electricity boards never ask you to install apps or call personal 10-digit mobile numbers for bill verification.
kyc_electricity.howItWorks: 1. An SMS warns power will be cut tonight at 9:30 PM for an unpaid bill. 2. It gives a 10-digit mobile number for an 'Officer'. 3. When called, they ask you to install a screen-sharing app. 4. They view your screen and steal your bank OTP.
kyc_electricity.hooks: "Power disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM" / "Call officer Shri Verma on 98XXXXXXXX immediately"
kyc_electricity.immediateAction: Do not call the number. Check your bill status directly on your official electricity board website or app.
kyc_electricity.fictionalText: Dear consumer electricity will be disconnected tonight at 09:30 PM because monthly bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our officer at 98765-43210.

fake_part_time_jobs.title: Work-From-Home / YouTube Like Task Scam
fake_part_time_jobs.summary: Promises easy daily income for liking videos, followed by demands to deposit money into Telegram 'prepaid tasks' where savings get trapped.
fake_part_time_jobs.goldenRule: A real job will never ask you to pay your own money to withdraw earnings.
fake_part_time_jobs.howItWorks: 1. A message offers ₹3,000 daily for liking videos or rating hotels. 2. They pay a small ₹150 reward to build trust. 3. They add you to a group and demand deposits of ₹5,000 for 'VIP tasks'. 4. They block all withdrawals and demand more fees.
fake_part_time_jobs.hooks: "Earn ₹3,000 daily working 30 mins" / "Recharge ₹10,000 to unlock your pending payout of ₹35,000"
fake_part_time_jobs.immediateAction: Block the sender right away. Never deposit money to unlock claimed earnings.
fake_part_time_jobs.fictionalText: Hello! We have daily freelance tasks liking hotel pages. Earn ₹3,000 daily. First task: like this video and send screenshot to get ₹150 in your UPI.

fake_loan_apps.title: Predatory / Fake Instant Loan Apps
fake_loan_apps.summary: Apps offering instant loans without documents that steal your contacts and photo gallery to harass and extort you.
fake_loan_apps.goldenRule: Never install loan apps from APK links or unofficial websites. Verify lenders on the RBI portal.
fake_loan_apps.howItWorks: 1. Social ads promise instant cash in 5 minutes with zero paperwork. 2. The app asks for full access to your Phone Contacts and Photos. 3. They disburse only a tiny amount and demand triple in 6 days. 4. They threaten to send morphed photos to your contacts.
fake_loan_apps.hooks: "Instant loan in 2 minutes without documents" / "Pay in 2 hours or we call your parents and contacts"
fake_loan_apps.immediateAction: Never download loan APKs from chat links. Verify registered NBFCs on the RBI Sachet portal.
fake_loan_apps.fictionalText: Permission required: To disburse your instant credit limit of ₹50,000, please grant access to your Phone Contacts, Storage, and Camera.

investment_crypto.title: Guaranteed Stock & Investment Groups
investment_crypto.summary: Fake WhatsApp/Telegram groups showing fake profits to trick you into transferring your savings to unverified accounts.
investment_crypto.goldenRule: Any investment scheme promising guaranteed high daily or weekly profits without risk is fraudulent.
investment_crypto.howItWorks: 1. You are added to a group claiming tips from top fund managers. 2. Accomplices post fake screenshots of huge earnings. 3. You are asked to put money into an unverified portal. 4. When you try to withdraw, they demand a 20% 'tax fee' and vanish.
investment_crypto.hooks: "Guaranteed 35% weekly profit" / "Transfer 18% TDS fee to release your balance"
investment_crypto.immediateAction: Stop transferring money. Check SEBI registration at sebi.gov.in and call 1930.
investment_crypto.fictionalText: Congratulations! Your account earned ₹4,80,000 profit today. To withdraw to your bank, transfer 18% tax of ₹86,400 to institutional ledger account.

otp_courier.title: Courier Parcel / ₹5 Address Update Scam
otp_courier.summary: SMS claiming an undelivered parcel from India Post or courier with a link to pay ₹5 or share an OTP for redelivery.
otp_courier.goldenRule: Never share an OTP or pay delivery fees through links received in unsolicited messages.
otp_courier.howItWorks: 1. SMS claims a package cannot be delivered due to wrong address. 2. It asks you to click a link and pay a tiny ₹5 fee. 3. The link opens a fake payment portal stealing your card details. 4. Criminals use the card and your OTP to steal large amounts.
otp_courier.hooks: "Package detained at hub due to incomplete address" / "Pay ₹5 re-dispatch charge within 12 hours"
otp_courier.immediateAction: Do not click the link. Track parcels only on the official courier website (.gov.in for India Post).
otp_courier.fictionalText: IndiaPost: Your package IND982194 cannot be dispatched due to wrong street address. Please update address & pay ₹5 within 12h: https://ind-post-redelivery.fictional

sensitive_extortion.title: Unknown Video Call & Blackmail Trap
sensitive_extortion.summary: Unknown video calls that capture your face and threaten to send fabricated screenshots to your family unless ransom is paid.
sensitive_extortion.goldenRule: Never answer unknown video calls. If targeted, do not pay money; block the number and report to 1930 immediately.
sensitive_extortion.howItWorks: 1. An unknown number makes a video call. 2. A recording captures your face. 3. Scammers send screenshots demanding money within 20 minutes. 4. Paying once leads to endless demands for more money.
sensitive_extortion.hooks: "We will send this video to your contact list in 15 minutes" / "Pay ₹25,000 right now or we upload it"
sensitive_extortion.immediateAction: Do not pay any money. Block the number, take screenshots for evidence, and call 1930 right away.
sensitive_extortion.fictionalText: URGENT: Your video record is ready. If you do not transfer ₹25,000 within 20 minutes, this file will be uploaded and sent to your family contacts.
